name: Face Index
description: Throwaway: labels images with a (mocked) face count so other apps can find them.

fileAccess.rationale: Reads images to detect faces. It never writes, modifies, or deletes an image — labelling is the only thing it does, and that needs no write grant.

labelKeys.description: This image contains at least one face.
How many faces were detected, as a decimal string.
